verdict.rationale: The evidence shows that Baseten API keys exist, since usage and costs can be queried and attributed per API key. Nothing documents issuing keys with restricted scopes, permissions, or least-privilege limits for an agent. Per-key usage attribution and workspace budgets are adjacent cost controls, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
